show_title: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke
premise: After being publicly abandoned at the altar by her fiancé, a humiliated noblewoman marries a scarred, mysterious veteran in exile, only to discover he is the rightful Duke of Ashburn destined to reclaim his stolen title. Together, they wage a relentless battle against aristocratic betrayal, poison, and wrongful execution to claim their rightful throne.

characters.description: Resilient, herbalist noblewoman who marries an exiled soldier and endures unimaginable cruelty.
Scared, formidable war veteran who is secretly the rightful Duke of Ashburn.
Treacherous former fiancé who abandons Juliana for her sister Clarissa.
Usurper and conspirator who seizes the ducal seat.
Ruthless noblewoman who poisons the Dowager Duchess and torments Juliana.
Alexander's mother, poisoned and imprisoned by the conspirators.
Loyal confidante who helps Juliana infiltrate Ashbury Manor.
Corrupt priest allied with Catherine in a treasonous plot.

continuous_arcs.title: Humiliation and Exile
continuous_arcs.core_conflict: Juliana is abandoned at the altar by Gerald, disowned by her family, and finds unexpected solace marrying a scarred warrior in a woodland cottage.

continuous_arcs.title: The Conspiracy Unveiled
continuous_arcs.core_conflict: Gerald and Clarissa launch targeted attacks and frame Alexander for theft, culminating in the destruction of their cottage and the discovery of a grand ducal usurpation.

continuous_arcs.title: The Poisoned Duchess
continuous_arcs.core_conflict: Juliana infiltrates Ashbury Manor to save the dying Dowager Duchess from arsenic poisoning, only to be framed for witchcraft by Rupert and Catherine.

continuous_arcs.title: Dungeon Trials and Vengeance
continuous_arcs.core_conflict: While Juliana endures brutal imprisonment and a false witchcraft trial, Alexander unites with his mother and loyal forces to shatter the wedding and reclaim his ducal throne.

continuous_arcs.title: Ecclesiastical Battle
continuous_arcs.core_conflict: The High Priest invalidates Alexander and Juliana's marriage while a humbled Catherine conspires in secret with Father Thomas during a ten-day reprieve.

major_spoilers.twist: Alexander's presumed-dead mother escapes her captivity and reunites with him in a mountain hideout, revealing the treasonous conspiracy behind his ambush.
Alexander crashes Rupert and Catherine's wedding in full ducal regalia, completely unmasking his identity as the true Duke of Ashburn.
The High Priest declares Alexander and Juliana's marriage legally invalid for lack of a royal license, sparking an emergency ecclesiastical trial.
